name: Northfold Manor
summary: At Refuge Pointe, Captain Nials seeks your help against the Syndicate at Northfold Manor. Their hold between Stromgarde's defenders and Southshore slows supplies.

sections.title: A Struggling Defense
sections.body: Ogres, the Syndicate and the Alliance divide Stromgarde, and the factions fight to a bloody stalemate. The Alliance's forces dwindle as their enemies grow. The defenders need help from Southshore, but supplies arrive slowly.

sections.title: The Syndicate at the Manor
sections.body: The Syndicate holds the ground between the defenders and Southshore. Captain Nials asks you to go to Northfold Manor, the Syndicate's base, and cut down their highwaymen and mercenaries. He hopes easing their pressure will let more supply trains through.

faq.q: Why does Captain Nials want the Syndicate attacked at Northfold Manor?
faq.answer: The Syndicate holds the land between the defenders and Southshore. Captain Nials hopes that slaying them at their base will ease the pressure on the supply trains.

faq.q: What is the current situation in Stromgarde?
faq.answer: Ogres, the Syndicate and the Alliance have divided Stromgarde, and the factions fight to a bloody stalemate. The Alliance's forces dwindle while its enemies grow.

faq.q: Where are the Alliance supplies coming from?
faq.answer: The defenders look to Southshore for help, but the Syndicate's hold on the land between makes supplies difficult to receive.

faq.q: Which enemies need to be eliminated at the manor?
faq.answer: Ten Syndicate Highwaymen and six Syndicate Mercenaries at Northfold Manor.
